messages:
arjun: quick callout — a new customer requires per-shard provenance (producer id, checksum chain, signed root) for audit. when we verify chains during cold-start it adds ~600ms. thoughts?

claire: merkle proofs in the header manifest would let us verify locally without extra registry roundtrips. header grows a bit but verification becomes O(log n) per shard.

mike: agree, merkle proofs trade header size for fewer network calls. need to watch header decrypt cost if encrypted. also must cache verified roots so repeated inits are cheap.

arjun: idea: header includes proof_root + compact per-shard proof blobs for high-priority shards only (kv + early base). loader verifies root signature once, then validates proofs for scheduled shards. unverified shards are treated as untrusted until checked.

claire: add verifier cache keyed by (producer_id, key_version, root_sig). TTL and manual invalidation on rotation. and metric provenance_verify_ms + provenance_failures.

mike: fallback: if proof fails, try alternate mirror, then re-download bundle from registry, then mark bundle degraded and route to fallback model. emit alert for mismatched provenance.

arjun: also need opt-in trust flag: only accept header-suggested hints if proof verifies and signer in allowlist. unsigned/invalid -> conservative scheduling.

provenance-bot: ticket INF-9999 created: "provenance-aware manifest + merkle proofs" (owner: arjun, reviewers: claire, mike)

arjun: spike next sprint: header schema + proof format + perf sim. claire + arjun prototype verifier, mike owns fallback policies. thanks :thumbsup:
